title: Bob skill pack manifest (pack.json)
description: One pack = one installable unit for IBM Bob: skills plus optional MCP servers, rules, slash commands and custom modes. Lives at packs/<vendor>/<name>/pack.json. The release tag is `<name>--v<version>`.

name.description: Pack id, unique across the registry. Used in `bob-skills add <name>` and `/skills-add <name>`.

version.description: Semantic version of the pack. A change to any shipped file requires a new version.

vendor.description: Vendor id from vendors.json. Must equal the parent folder under packs/.

safety.description: Known risks a user must see before installing: what the pack's skills do that needs care, and what closes it. Shown by `bob-skills show`, by `add`, in the offline catalog and on the website. A pack whose skills write to external systems declares it here.

class.description: writes: changes outside the workspace; cost: billable resources; content: outside content can steer actions; transport: TLS or exposure; data: data leaves the machine.

warning.description: What the skills do, in the user's terms.

covered.description: What closes it in practice: the rule, the confirmation step, the setting.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the shipped content, e.g. MIT.

source.description: Upstream the skills were synced from, when they are not authored in this registry.

ref.description: Tag or commit in the upstream repository.

minBob.description: Minimum IBM Bob version the pack was tested with.

skills.description: Skill folders under skills/. Each must contain SKILL.md whose frontmatter `name` equals the folder name and has a non-empty `description` (Bob ignores a skill without one).

mcpServers.description: Servers merged into .bob/mcp.json (project) or ~/.bob/mcp.json (--global). Keys are server names. Checked by the registry: pinned versions, https, no secrets, no pre-approved tools, TLS verification on.

mcpAccess.description: Reviewed access level of every server in mcpServers. read-only: how writes are kept out (a tool allow-list, a read-only mode, or a server that only reads). read-write: why the pack needs writes and which confirmation guards each one. The registry refuses a pack whose server has no entry.

commands.description: Bob Shell slash commands copied into .bob/commands/.

modes.description: Custom modes file whose `customModes` entries are merged by slug into .bob/custom_modes.yaml.

networkAllow.description: Hosts (glob) the pack's scripts may contact. Must be a subset of the vendor's allow-list in vendors.json. Anything else in code is a blocking policy finding.

revokedVersions.description: Versions the vendor has withdrawn. The installer refuses them, `update` offers a rollback, the guard refuses to activate their skills.

checksums.description: Digest per shipped component. Maintained by `bob-skills registry validate --fix`; CI fails when a checksum does not match the tree. See docs/pack-format.md for the algorithm.

generated.description: Files inside the pack that the registry tooling regenerates (for example the offline catalog in find-skills). They are checksummed like everything else, but a difference against the release tag in these files does not require a new version.

sources.description: Per-skill upstream overrides for packs curated from more than one repository; keys are skill names, values have the shape of `source`.
